snippet.title: Disney's Chicken Little [42] 100% GameCube Longplay
snippet.description:
Disney's Chicken Little is a 2005 action-adventure game that follows the plot of the movie. In order to get 100%, I collected all of the card sets which are used to unlock the six multiplayer games after you complete the story.

This longplay was requested by: Herbert Wiggins
